title: Permissions API policy input
description: JSON document Sombra posts as `{ input }` when evaluating a Permissions policy bundle via the OPA Data API.

preferences.description: Purpose preference rows from Preference Store for the current subject.

name.description: Purpose slug (for example Analytics or SaleOfInfo).

choice.description: true when opted in, false when opted out, or null when unset.

days_since_choice.description: Whole days since the preference was last set. Omitted when no timestamp is available.

topics.description: Topic choices stored under this purpose. Omitted when the purpose has none; unset topics are absent rather than padded.

name.description: Topic slug (for example Frequency or SnowAlerts).

choice.description: Boolean topic choice, single-select value, multi-select values, or null when unset.

context.description: Caller-supplied context for the decision (for example region). Use an empty object when none is provided.
